belluno.subtitle: Belluno province and three present-day municipalities
belluno.date_note: * Earlier reconstruction: mainly 1875–1876; Pieve di Cadore sheet 1908, Aviano 1916, Conegliano 1918. These substitutions overlap the later period, so the interval is not uniform across the study area.
belluno.early_note: Main series: 1875–1876. Substitute sheets: Pieve di Cadore (1908), Aviano (1916), Conegliano (1918).

dolina.subtitle: Dolina district

dolina.late_note: Main series: 1914. Okormezo sheet: 1907. Porohy: year unspecified; attribution to the 1914 series remains provisional.

szeben.subtitle: Szeben County
szeben.date_note: Sheet dates span 1875–1879 for the earlier reconstruction and 1912–1915 for the later reconstruction.
